column1: # CPU-only timing on a2 (2026-10-16): 4 x Intel Xeon Gold 5218 (x86-64, Cascade Lake, AVX-512), 64 cores in 4 NUMA nodes, no GPU, no thread pinning; 64 threads per pipeline.

# Build ~/certa-cpu = commit 12076c3 (CPU code as 474ad90), g++ 13.3 -O3 -DNDEBUG -march=native, without zlib (uncompressed input is memory-mapped either way); index q=22 s=1 built on a2. 20,001,073 reads (single-end, R1) or pairs, SAM discarded. Script: a2:~/certa-bench/cpu/run_a2.sh.

# Rows up to the first bwa-mem2 row: warm-up, then the thread-split scan (one run each; the certified tier ran twice). Then, in one session: BWA-MEM2, minibwa and CERTA CPU + minibwa at the best split (32:32), three times each; then one paired run of each (CERTA 40:24).
# certa-cpu-pipe / certa-cpu-pe-pipe: CERTA without a GPU (certa_threads) streaming its uncertified reads or pairs into minibwa (64 - certa_threads).
